rules.rationale: This rule is the compile-time scanBody macro expansion naming the exact loop-body AST; it defines a proof term and adds no independent execution or mathematical fact.
This rule is the compile-time moveOneBallBody macro expansion for the exact translated function body, so it is a named structural definition rather than an operational extension.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the allInts domain predicate.
This is the constructor recurrence defining allInts by checking the head and recursively checking the tail.

This simplification rule adds a guarded sort-refinement fact about applyCmp rather than defining a new symbol. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before all kprove runs and contains no prior exact proof against a module without it.
This is the empty-input base equation for the scanDrops accumulator summary.
This is the guarded tail-recursive step equation defining the scanDrops mathematical fold.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the lastAfter structural summary.
This is the constructor recurrence defining lastAfter by advancing to the head and consuming the tail.

This simplification rule adds a guarded mathematical fact permitting comparison with lastAfter. Stage 1 uses it in the compiled proof theory and provides no earlier exact proof in a module from which this rule is absent.
This guarded equation defines moveSpec on the empty sequence.
This guarded equation defines moveSpec on the nonempty all-integer domain in terms of the scanDrops and lastAfter summaries.
